title: Quality Studio performance
summary: Tracks measured startup, repository switching, tree transport, review-run latency, rendering, and long-session memory. QS-82 implements the lazy tree transport slice and integrates QS-78 snapshot restoration without duplicating QS-54 cache work; re-measured on 2026-08-24 against origin/main e31089c and independently reproduced on the committed tree b36bfe3 the same day. Reconciled on 2026-08-28 with QS-86, replayed and fully re-gated on 2026-09-01 against origin/main 7d3abdf, then rebased on 2026-09-07 onto origin/main 6b4e7b3, which had landed the frontend service split, a bounded dashboard LRU, a Git-fingerprint TTL, and derived function units. Eleven conflicts were resolved onto main's newer structure with no feature reworked; build, dotnet format, 547 .NET tests, 144 Angular tests, lint, production build, and the 13-point tree-v2 contract are green. The full build.yml gate was replayed on 2026-09-07, which surfaced and fixed one real defect in this diff: the browser performance harness still stubbed only the recursive tree route, so its fixture had gone dead and the run silently measured the live repository. Section 10 records the fix, the restored fixture budgets, and a correction to section 9 about the machine-bound dashboard budget. Later the same evening main advanced three commits further and the delivery was rebased again, conflict-free, onto origin/main 24824c2; the full gate was replayed on that base and is green, including the test step that had previously died of host OOM. Section 11 records that replay.
